+    def _get_pacman_license(self, package_name: str) -> List[str]:
+        """Get license information for a Pacman package."""
+        try:
+            result = subprocess.run(
+                ["pacman", "-Qi", package_name],
+                capture_output=True,
+                text=True,
+                check=True
+            )
+            
+            # Parse the output to find license information
+            for line in result.stdout.split('\n'):
+                if line.startswith('Licenses'):
+                    # Extract licenses after the colon
+                    license_part = line.split(':', 1)[1].strip()
+                    if license_part and license_part != 'None':
+                        # Split multiple licenses
+                        licenses = [lic.strip() for lic in license_part.split()]
+                        return licenses if licenses else ["unknown"]
+            
+            return ["unknown"]
+            
+        except (subprocess.CalledProcessError, FileNotFoundError):
